description: Defines data structures, functions, and constants for querying and handling OpenGL image formats within the ANGLE project, including format types, internal formats, and vertex attribute formats.
external_methods: GetVertexFormatID(VertexAttribType type, GLboolean normalized, GLuint components, bool pureInteger)
ValidES3FormatCombination(GLenum format, GLenum type, GLenum internalFormat)
ValidDesktopFormatCombination(GLenum format, GLenum type, GLenum internalFormat)

classes.name: FormatType
classes.description: Represents a specific combination of GL format and type.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Encapsulates information about the size and interpretation of a GL type.

classes.name: InternalFormat
classes.description: Contains detailed information about an OpenGL internal format, including size, support, and properties.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Wraps an InternalFormat, representing either sized or unsized formats.

classes.name: AttributeType
classes.description: Enumerates the types of vertex shader input attributes.

classes.name: VertexFormat
classes.description: Describes the format of a vertex attribute, including type, normalization, components, and integer status.

methods.name: GetTypeInfo
methods.description: Returns type information based on a GLenum type.

methods.name: GetDrawElementsTypeSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a DrawElementsType.

methods.name: GetDrawElementsTypeShift
methods.description: Returns the shift value associated with a DrawElementsType.

methods.name: computePixelBytes
methods.description: Calculates pixel size in bytes for a given format type.

methods.name: computeRowPitch
methods.description: Calculates the row pitch for image data.

methods.name: computeDepthPitch
methods.description: Calculates the depth pitch for 3D images.

methods.name: computeCompressedImageSize
methods.description: Calculates size of compressed image data.

methods.name: computeSkipBytes
methods.description: Calculates bytes to skip for image upload.

methods.name: computePackUnpackEndByte
methods.description: Calculates end bytes for packing/unpacking images.

methods.name: isLUMA
methods.description: Checks if the format is a luminance format.

methods.name: getReadPixelsFormat
methods.description: Returns the format used for reading pixels.

methods.name: getReadPixelsType
methods.description: Returns the type used for reading pixels.

methods.name: supportSubImage
methods.description: Indicates if sub-image upload is supported.

methods.name: isRequiredRenderbufferFormat
methods.description: Checks if format is a required renderbuffer format for a given version.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the format is an integer format.

methods.name: isDepthOrStencil
methods.description: Checks if the format is depth or stencil.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison for InternalFormat.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison for InternalFormat.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the Format object is valid.

methods.name: Invalid
methods.description: Returns an invalid Format object.

methods.name: SameSized
methods.description: Checks if two formats are the same size.

methods.name: EquivalentForBlit
methods.description: Checks if two formats are equivalent for blitting.

methods.name: GetSizedInternalFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves internal format info for a sized internal format.

methods.name: GetInternalFormatInfo
methods.description: Retrieves internal format info for a given internal format and type.

methods.name: GetUnsizedFormat
methods.description: Gets the unsized format from an internal format.

methods.name: CompressedFormatRequiresWholeImage
methods.description: Checks if compressed format requires whole image upload.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatID
methods.description: Gets a FormatID for a vertex attribute format.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatFromID
methods.description: Retrieves VertexFormat from a FormatID.

methods.name: GetVertexFormatSize
methods.description: Returns size of a vertex format.

methods.name: ValidES3InternalFormat
methods.description: Checks if an internal format is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3Format
methods.description: Checks if a format is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3Type
methods.description: Checks if a type is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidES3FormatCombination
methods.description: Checks if a format/type combination is valid in ES3.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormat
methods.description: Checks if a format is valid on desktop OpenGL.

methods.name: ValidDesktopType
methods.description: Checks if a type is valid on desktop OpenGL.

methods.name: ValidDesktopFormatCombination
methods.description: Checks if a format/type combination is valid on desktop.

methods.name: ValidES3CopyConversion
methods.description: Checks if a copy conversion is valid in ES3.

methods.name: GetVertexAttributeComponentType
methods.description: Determines component type for vertex attribute based on purity and type.
